# Canva Design Checklist

Professional design criteria for creating high-quality resumes and documents in Canva.

## Content Clarity

- [ ] **Name is prominent** - Largest text on the page, immediately visible
- [ ] **Contact information is clear** - Email, phone, and LinkedIn easily readable
- [ ] **Section headings are obvious** - Different from body text, clear hierarchy
- [ ] **Bullet points are concise** - Each point is 1-2 lines, action-oriented
- [ ] **No typos or grammar errors** - Proofread multiple times
- [ ] **Consistent formatting** - Dates, job titles, and sections follow same pattern

## Visual Hierarchy

- [ ] **Clear size differences** - Name > Section titles > Content
- [ ] **Font weight varies appropriately** - Bold for titles, regular for body
- [ ] **Color draws attention** - Primary color for headers, neutral for body
- [ ] **White space is used effectively** - Adequate margin between sections
- [ ] **Elements are aligned** - Text lines up, not scattered randomly
- [ ] **Symmetry or balance** - Layout feels organized and intentional

## Color & Contrast

- [ ] **Text is readable** - At least 4.5:1 contrast ratio between text and background
- [ ] **Only 2-3 main colors** - Not too many colors creating visual chaos
- [ ] **Professional colors** - Avoids neon, bright, or overly casual colors
- [ ] **Accent color is used sparingly** - For emphasis, not everywhere
- [ ] **Background is clean** - White, light gray, or subtle pattern
- [ ] **Color choice matches industry** - Tech = modern, Finance = conservative, Creative = artistic

## Typography

- [ ] **Font choices are professional** - 2-3 fonts maximum
- [ ] **Font sizes differ clearly** - Name is 1.5-2x larger than body
- [ ] **Line length is readable** - Not too narrow or too wide
- [ ] **Line spacing is adequate** - Text isn't cramped or too spaced out
- [ ] **Serif vs Sans-serif** - Consistent choice (don't mix old-style and modern)
- [ ] **Avoid decorative fonts for body** - Only for headers/accents if at all

## Layout & Spacing

- [ ] **Margins are consistent** - Equal space on all sides (or intentionally different)
- [ ] **Sections are clearly separated** - Visible gap between each section
- [ ] **No crowding** - Sufficient whitespace makes design feel professional
- [ ] **Single or dual column** - Layout choice is clear and intentional
- [ ] **Alignment is consistent** - Left, right, or center aligned (not mixed)
- [ ] **No awkward text wrapping** - Lines break naturally, no orphaned words

## Content Structure

- [ ] **Chronological order** - Experience in reverse order (newest first)
- [ ] **Education includes dates** - Graduation date or expected graduation
- [ ] **Skills are organized** - By category (Languages, Tools, Soft Skills) or proficiency level
- [ ] **Relevant content only** - Nothing outdated or irrelevant
- [ ] **Quantifiable achievements** - Includes numbers/metrics where possible
- [ ] **Action verbs** - Experience bullets start with strong verbs (Led, Developed, Increased)

## ATS Compatibility (if submitting digitally)

- [ ] **No images as content** - Images can't be read by applicant tracking systems
- [ ] **Standard fonts only** - Avoid decorative or custom fonts
- [ ] **Simple formatting** - Bold and italic OK, complex effects won't transfer
- [ ] **Text isn't overlaid on images** - All text is plain text
- [ ] **Columns are simple** - Avoid complex multi-column layouts
- [ ] **No graphics or logos** - Unless they're part of company branding

## Visual Polish

- [ ] **Logo or accent element** - Optional but adds professionalism
- [ ] **Consistent iconography** - If using icons, style is consistent
- [ ] **No pixelated images** - All images are high quality
- [ ] **Background is appropriate** - Complements content without distraction
- [ ] **Overall design is cohesive** - All elements work together
- [ ] **Print preview looks good** - If printing, verify PDF export quality

## Final Review

- [ ] **Passes the 5-second test** - Key info visible at a glance
- [ ] **Looks good in black & white** - If color doesn't work, design is still strong
- [ ] **Mobile view is acceptable** - Readable on phone/tablet screens
- [ ] **PDF export is high quality** - No artifacts, blurry text, or compression issues
- [ ] **One full page** - For standard resume, fits on single page
- [ ] **Ready to share** - You'd be comfortable sending this to hiring manager

## Before/After Comparison

### Before (Common Issues)
- [ ] Too many fonts and colors
- [ ] Text too small or cramped
- [ ] Weak hierarchy, hard to scan
- [ ] Irrelevant information included
- [ ] Inconsistent formatting
- [ ] Outdated design style

### After (Professional)
- [ ] Clear, clean design
- [ ] Readable font sizes
- [ ] Strong visual hierarchy
- [ ] Relevant, concise content
- [ ] Consistent styling throughout
- [ ] Modern, professional appearance

## Quick Scoring

**Score yourself on each section:**
- 8+ items checked in each section = Professional quality
- 6-7 items = Good, minor improvements needed
- <6 items = Needs significant revision

**Overall checklist:**
- [ ] 90%+ items checked = Ready to submit
- [ ] 80-90% checked = One more review recommended
- [ ] <80% checked = Needs more work before submitting
